versions.changelog:
Initial release – safely clean up C drive space by user-confirmed, whitelist-only methods.

- Scans only approved, non-system directories like temp/cache/logs; WPS cache included if detected.
- Each directory is explained (usage, source of clutter, deletion impact) in Chinese before prompting user confirmation.
- Only deletes directory contents after explicit user consent, keeping directory structure intact.
- Never scans whole drive, deletes downloads/desktop files, modifies registry, or touches system core directories.
- Generates a detailed Markdown cleanup log with time, actions, results, and released space for each directory.
- Provides a PowerShell script for usage, supporting dry-run and custom log paths.
